citation: Seo et al., 2021, Prolonged postoperative ileus following right- versus left-sided colectomy
population_or_comparison: 9 studies identified; 7 included in meta-analysis; 29068 colectomies (14581 right, 14487 left)
surgical_exposure_reported: right-sided versus left-sided colectomy; individual anatomic structures not resolved
poi_or_ppoi_result: PPOI more likely after right-sided colectomy: OR 1.78 (95% CI 1.32-2.39); heterogeneous definitions
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: adjusted multivariable sensitivity analysis remained directionally consistent
regional_field_resolution: low; resection side rather than operation-level structures
interpretation_for_gate1: supports a broad right-sided signal but cannot establish a hepatic-flexure/transverse-field effect
key_limitation: PPOI definitions heterogeneous; secondary recovery outcomes sparse

citation: Garfinkle et al., 2020, Are right-sided colectomies for neoplastic disease at increased risk of primary postoperative ileus compared to left-sided colectomies?
population_or_comparison: 40636 NSQIP colectomies; 12949 matched patients per group
surgical_exposure_reported: right colectomy versus left colectomy; specific field structures not reported
poi_or_ppoi_result: pPOI 11.5% after right colectomy versus 8.8% after left colectomy
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: right colectomy associated with higher pPOI odds: OR 1.35 (95% CI 1.25-1.47)
interpretation_for_gate1: supports a reproducible side-associated signal, but not the proposed regional exposure variable
key_limitation: database procedure categories do not reconstruct actual dissection field

citation: Parnasa et al., 2025, Right extended hemicolectomy with ileo-descending anastomosis is associated with prolonged postoperative ileus and longer hospital stay compared to right or left hemicolectomy
surgical_exposure_reported: REC involved resection extending through ascending, transverse and proximal descending colon; detailed structure-by-structure dissection not extracted
poi_or_ppoi_result: REC associated with longer time to flatus, delayed solid-diet tolerance, higher NGT use and longer LOS; study conclusion reports higher PPOI
dge_result: not reported as a separate endpoint
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: analysis of covariance identified REC as an independent PPOI risk factor
regional_field_resolution: moderate for extended-resection category; low for individual structures
interpretation_for_gate1: supports an exposure-gradient hypothesis because REC differs from RC/LC by extent, but does not isolate which structure matters
key_limitation: retrospective single-center design; exact PPOI incidence and operative-field components require full-text extraction

citation: Chi and Huang, 2022, Delayed gastric emptying after surgery for transverse colon cancer: diagnosis, management and prevention
design: Chinese-language clinical report/review with retrospective institutional data described in abstract
population_or_comparison: transverse-colon cancer surgery compared with other colon cancer surgery; subgroup by gastrocolic-ligament lymph-node dissection
surgical_exposure_reported: transverse colon surgery; gastrocolic-ligament/infrapyloric lymph-node dissection
dge_result: reported DGE incidence 4.0% after transverse-colon cancer surgery; gastrocolic-ligament lymph-node dissection 3.6% versus 0.8% without it
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: retrospective comparison reported; full model details not extracted
regional_field_resolution: moderate for DGE signal; moderate-low for causal field inference
interpretation_for_gate1: directly supports a transverse/gastrocolic-field DGE signal and justifies separating DGE from POI
key_limitation: abstract does not provide complete cohort definition, adjustment set or diagnostic adjudication details; full text required

citation: Popescu et al., 2023, Prevention of delayed gastric emptying after right colectomy with extended lymphadenectomy: a randomized controlled trial
population_or_comparison: 64 patients randomized; proximal transverse-colon cancer; right colectomy with extensive lymphadenectomy including gastrocolic nodes
surgical_exposure_reported: proximal transverse colon; extended lymphadenectomy; gastrocolic-node dissection; intervention was gastropexy versus conventional surgery
dge_result: DGE 38.7% in conventional group versus 12.1% with gastropexy (P=0.014)
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: univariate analysis showed lower DGE risk with gastropexy; no causal comparison of field exposure itself
regional_field_resolution: moderate; field context is explicit, but exposure was not randomized
interpretation_for_gate1: supports a clinically meaningful DGE phenotype and a possible local structural mechanism after this surgical field is entered
key_limitation: small single-center trial; gastropexy is a co-intervention and does not identify the responsible structure

citation: Aden et al., 2024, Predictive factors for postoperative ileus after elective right hemicolectomy performed on over 80% ERAS-adherent patients
population_or_comparison: 499 elective laparoscopic right/extended-right colectomies; ERAS-adherent analysis group n=271
surgical_exposure_reported: right or extended-right colectomy; transverse-colon tumor location recorded; detailed field components not reported
poi_or_ppoi_result: POI occurred in 24/271 (8.9%) in the high-ERAS group; transverse tumor location associated in univariate analysis
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: operative time >200 minutes and POD2 opioid use independently predicted POI; transverse location did not remain an independent predictor in the reported model
regional_field_resolution: low-moderate; location signal attenuated after adjustment
interpretation_for_gate1: important partial counterevidence: tumor location alone may not explain POI once operative and perioperative factors are considered
key_limitation: single-center retrospective study; analysis restricted to right-sided operations and does not encode surgical-field exposure

citation: Kim et al., 2023, Effect of intracorporeal anastomosis on postoperative ileus after laparoscopic right colectomy
population_or_comparison: 108 laparoscopic right colectomies: intracorporeal anastomosis 45, extracorporeal anastomosis 63
surgical_exposure_reported: anastomotic technique; not an anatomic-field comparison
poi_or_ppoi_result: ileus 2.2% with intracorporeal versus 14.3% with extracorporeal anastomosis; first flatus earlier with intracorporeal technique
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: extracorporeal anastomosis and prior abdominal operation were independent predictors in the reported model
regional_field_resolution: not applicable to regional field; technical confounder
interpretation_for_gate1: shows that operation technique can influence POI and must be separated from anatomic exposure in Phase 0
key_limitation: small retrospective study; right colectomy only; technique selection may be confounded

citation: Uchida et al., 2023, Incidence of and risk factors for postoperative ileus between right and left laparoscopic colectomy using propensity-score-matched analysis
population_or_comparison: 1986 laparoscopic colectomies; after matching 803 right and 803 left
surgical_exposure_reported: right versus left laparoscopic colectomy; individual structures not reported
poi_or_ppoi_result: postoperative ileus 6.4% after right colectomy versus 3.2% after left colectomy after matching
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: male sex and prior abdominal surgery were reported predictors among right-side cases
regional_field_resolution: low; side and patient factors, not field components
interpretation_for_gate1: supports a right-side signal but also demonstrates competing patient and prior-surgery explanations
key_limitation: abstract reports an apparent p-value inconsistency for one hazard-ratio result; full text should be checked before quantitative synthesis

citation: Millan et al., 2012, Risk factors for prolonged postoperative ileus after colorectal cancer surgery
design: retrospective analysis of prospectively maintained database
surgical_exposure_reported: mixed colorectal procedures; no hepatic-flexure/transverse-field variable reported
poi_or_ppoi_result: POI 15.9%; mean LOS 11 days without POI versus 20 days with POI
multivariable_or_adjusted_result: male sex, COPD and ileostomy were independent predictors
regional_field_resolution: not applicable to regional field; general confounder reference
interpretation_for_gate1: negative-control context: POI is strongly influenced by patient and procedure factors outside the proposed field
key_limitation: older cohort and broad procedure mix; not designed to test regional exposure
